_comment: Development-only behavioral cases. Run with and without the skill in disposable fixtures and compare outcomes; these expectations are not captured passing results. All forge responses and lifecycle facts are supplied by the evaluator, all mutations are recording stubs, and no live tools or credentials are used.

evals.prompt: Select the next eligible local issue. The main tree is on pr.base and the lock is held. Issue 0041 has frontmatter state: blocked and a body code example containing state: ready. Issue 0042 has frontmatter state: "ready". Use only the supplied fixture facts; report the selected issue and intended first state change, without implementing or contacting a forge.
evals.expected_output: Only 0042 is selected; body text cannot authorize 0041.
expectations: Reads only opening frontmatter and accepts paired double quotes.
Rechecks expected frontmatter state before proposing ready to working.

evals.prompt: A ready issue was selected, but before claiming it its opening frontmatter changes to done; the body still includes state: ready. Describe the claim outcome and file effects without doing work.
evals.expected_output: The claim aborts without a tracker write.
expectations: Does not rely on the earlier queue result.
Rejects the changed expected state before writing.
Preserves the original issue and body.

evals.prompt: Select local issues from four files: one has two top-level state keys (blocked and ready); one has no closing frontmatter delimiter; one has complete frontmatter without state but a body state: ready example; one has complete frontmatter state: ready. Report parsing and eligibility without mutations.
evals.expected_output: Malformed files are reported; missing state is not readiness.
expectations: Reports duplicate keys and unclosed frontmatter as errors.
Does not treat body text or absent state as ready.
Does not silently report a clean or empty queue when parsing failed.

evals.prompt: Reconcile a Linear working orphan for selected immutable issue id L-123, key ENG-123, team T, repo label repo: acme/app. The trusted checkout is github.com/acme/app, base dev, and the recorded issue branch is ai/ENG-123-fix. The complete attachment list contains one GitHub PR URL https://github.com/acme/other/pull/7, which a supplied external summary says is merged. Use fixture facts only; list proposed reads and writes, without contacting tools.
evals.expected_output: The foreign PR does not establish an artifact or authorize reconciliation.
expectations: Does not query or mutate the foreign PR.
Does not treat a mismatched attachment as absence and reclaim working to ready.
Reports binding failure only through the selected in-scope immutable Linear issue id, or locally if scope cannot be reconfirmed.

evals.prompt: Selected Linear issue id L-200, key ENG-200, team T, repo label repo: acme/app depends on immutable issue L-123. The dependency lookup shows L-123 belongs to repo: acme/other and carries a merged GitHub PR attachment for acme/other. The trusted checkout is github.com/acme/app, base dev. Decide whether to start ENG-200 and which external reads/writes are needed using only fixture facts.
evals.expected_output: A foreign dependency PR cannot satisfy the same-repository merge gate.
expectations: Defers ENG-200 without leasing or implementing it.
Does not fetch or mutate the foreign PR or prerequisite.
Reports the unresolved dependency scope rather than claiming its work landed on this repo base.

evals.prompt: The selected Linear issue L-123 is in the bound team and repo github.com/acme/app. During feedback lookup its attachment collection cannot be fully read; the first page has no PR. feedback=pr and the planned comment is a normal changes-requested verdict. State the next action without live tool use.
evals.expected_output: An unreadable attachment set is a binding error, not a no-PR fallback.
expectations: Does not post the normal verdict through the no-PR fallback.
Does not guess or search another repository for a PR.
Stops PR-dependent work and reports the lookup failure on the selected issue by immutable id after scope confirmation.
